original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: E-selectinSCR2 was dialyzed overnight at 4 °C against assay buffer containing 20 mM Tris HCl, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM CaCl2, pH 7.4. Compounds were dissolved in assay buffer from dialysis. E-selectinSCR2 and compound concentration respectively were: 80 μM/2 mM for 5; 82.5 μM/1.35 mM for 6; 67 μM/1 mM for 7; 29 μM/400 μM for 8; 24 μM/300 μM for 11b. ITC experiments were conducted in duplicate on a VP-ITC instrument (Malvern Panalytical) at 25 °C using an injection volume of 6–15 μL at a reference power of 10 μcal/s, stirring speed of 307 rpm and high feedback mode/gain. Baseline adjustment and peak integration were carried out using Origin 7.0 (OriginLab). A global three-parameter data fitting was processed to determine n (stoichiometry), KA (association constant) and ΔH° using the ITCsy software [47], except for 5 where n was fixed to 1. Thermogram figures were plotted with GUSSI [48]. Thermodynamic parameters of test compounds to E-selectinSCR2 [40] are reported in Table S3, Supplementary Material.

Yellow circle highlights the region with sulfate forming a salt bridge to His114. Calcium ion is depicted as a green sphere; sulfated l-tyrosine of PLGL-1 is abbreviated as sTyr.
